learningUnits.title: For/ While/ Do while loops
learningUnits.concept: A loop repeats a block of work. Use a for loop when the number or range of iterations is naturally count-based, while when continuation depends on a condition, and do-while when the body must execute at least once. A loop should always have a clear progress rule toward termination.
learningUnits.content: A loop repeats a block of work. Use a for loop when the number or range of iterations is naturally count-based, while when continuation depends on a condition, and do-while when the body must execute at least once. A loop should always have a clear progress rule toward termination.
learningUnits.approach:
Identify what one iteration should do.
Write the initialization, continuation condition, and update separately.
